name: I Love You, Brother
source: MC-kun's mother just remarried with her boss who has a child of his own. And thus, MC-kun got a lovely little brother. Not long after, the two newly married went on honeymoon and left the two kids alone for two weeks. During the two weeks, MC-kun has to bond with his new little brother and maybe meet some other guys.
translation: 主人公的母亲再婚了，对方是她的上司，而且那位上司也有一个孩子。就这样，主人公得到了一个可爱的弟弟。不久后，新婚夫妇去度蜜月，把两个孩子独自留在家里两周。接下来的两周里，主人公必须与新弟弟培养感情，也许还会遇见其他男孩。
